dog.description_text:
Cracker Jack is a 5-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 20 lbs, and he has one of those looks you don’t forget: a Lab-like head on a long little Dachshund-style body.

Despite signs that life hasn’t always been kind to him, Jack is incredibly trusting, sweet, and easygoing. He doesn’t seem easily fazed, is wonderful on walks, and happily says hello to both people and other dogs. He also has the cutest little hop when he picks up the pace, which somehow makes him even more charming.

Cracker Jack is just a lovely little guy who seems happy to be along for the ride and close to his people.

Registered adopters interested in Cracker Jack can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
